journeys.text:
Journeys, screen by screen

A Save for later: Home MVP > Quick add > Backlog
B Capture from phone: iPhone Shortcut > Home MVP (Waiting for a name) > Quick add (naming)
C Explore an album: Backlog (Start) > Item detail (status, rating, review)
D Explore an artist: Quick add (artist) > Item detail (artist) > Backlog
E Rediscover: Rediscover > Item detail > Open Spotify
F Listening history: Settings > Import > Recent plays > Insights
G Clean up a playlist: Playlists check-up > Studio > Apply > Undo
H Back up and restore: Settings (Back up now, Restore)

states-mvp.text:
States, MVP row

Home MVP, first run: only the add field and one line, Paste a Spotify link to start your backlog.
Quick add: duplicate, unsupported and offline drawn on the board.
Backlog empty: Nothing waiting. Paste a link or share from your phone. Filter with no results: offers Clear filters.
Item detail offline: embed shows the neutral placeholder; everything else works.
Library empty: one line plus Add. Search with no match: Nothing matches, with Clear search.
Rediscover: a shelf with nothing in it is hidden; if all are empty, a line explains how shelves fill up.
Errors everywhere: inline under the control that failed, never a toast.

states-r2.text:
States, Release 2 row

Recent plays empty: logger off or nothing played yet; buttons to turn the logger on or import an export.
Logger error: Windows media info unavailable, shown in the logger card; the rest works.
Insights before any data: explains the two sources with Import and Turn on logger.
Insights with stale export: freshness line turns accent and suggests a new export.
Import wrong folder and re-import drawn on the board.

states-r3.text:
States, Release 3 row

Not connected: Playlists keeps the export check-up; Studio and From Spotify show Connect Spotify only.
Sign-in expired (6 months): one banner, Reconnect Spotify.
Premium lapsed or Spotify down: Spotify features say why and pause; nothing else is affected.
Playlist changed on Spotify: drawn on the Playlists board.
Settings, backup too large: warning under Backups, backup still kept.
